liturgicalName: The Nativity of the Lord (Christmas Day)
keyVerseDR: "And the Word was made flesh and dwelt among us..." (Jn 1:14)

level1.title: Jesus Is Born!
level1.story: Before anything was made, Jesus, the Word, was with God. Jesus is God! At Christmas, the Word became a baby and lived with us.
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
questions: What gift can you give Jesus?
level1.prayer: Baby Jesus, thank You for coming. Amen.

activity.title: Jesus is born!
activity.intro: Decorate the letters for Jesus' birthday.

level2.title: The Word Became Flesh
level2.story: "In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God." All things were made by Him, and in Him was life, and the life was the light of men. The light shines in darkness, and the darkness did not overcome it. "And the Word was made flesh, and dwelt among us." We have seen His glory, full of grace and truth.
level2.keyLine: The Word was made flesh and dwelt among us.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: What does 'the Word was made flesh' mean?
How can you be a light to others?
level2.prayer: Jesus, Word made flesh, shine in my heart. Amen.

activity.title: The Word became flesh
activity.intro: Read it, fold one line at a time, and say it from memory.
activity.question: What happened at Christmas?
activity.answer: And the Word was made flesh, and dwelt among us.
